title: Case Study: King Salman Financial Tower — Glass Facade
challenge: Executing 45,000 m² of structural glass facades on a 60-storey government tower, meeting the demanding SBC-601 thermal energy code requirements, within a tight 18-month schedule.
solution: We adopted a Unitized Curtain Wall system with bespoke double-glazed insulated units carrying a silver Low-E coating, fitted with high-performance thermal barriers to achieve a U-value not exceeding 1.8 W/m²K. A precision parallel manufacturing and installation schedule ensured on-time delivery.

testimonial.quote: Al Fahd Contracting delivered the project with rare professionalism, fully meeting technical specifications and schedule.
testimonial.author: Eng. Ahmed Al-Harthy

title: Case Study: NEOM Infrastructure Hub — Modular Steel Structures
challenge: Constructing 120,000 m² of modular steel structures in a harsh desert environment with wind loads exceeding 160 km/h, under strict NEOM and Vision 2030 sustainability requirements.
solution: We developed a modular assembly system with standardised units coated with a three-layer protection system (Zinc Rich + Epoxy + Polyurethane), with full BIM coordination to ensure precision field erection in challenging site conditions.

title: Case Study: Red Sea Global Pavilion — Sustainable Facades
challenge: Executing architectural glass facades in an environmentally sensitive coastal location, with LEED Platinum requirements and strict constraints on carbon footprint and Red Sea ecosystem protection.
solution: We used 75% recycled low-carbon aluminium, CNC-parametric glass panels, and VOC-free eco-friendly coatings. All material specifications were fully documented for the complete LEED submission file.

testimonial.quote: Al Fahd Contracting proved to be the ideal partner for luxury sustainable tourism projects in Saudi Arabia.
testimonial.author: Eng. Sarah Al-Omari

title: Case Study: Rolls-Royce Showroom — Ultra-Clear Spider Glass
scope: 1,500 m² of low-iron glass in a Spider system
challenge: Installing a frameless glass facade with absolute optical clarity befitting the Rolls-Royce brand — large low-iron glass panels with zero colour distortion — within a 10-week schedule.
solution: We selected 12 mm Extra-Clear low-iron glass fixed with a Spider system using austenitic stainless steel fittings. A two-week prototype phase preceded manufacturing to confirm compliance with the strict optical quality standard.

testimonial.quote: The result exceeded our expectations — the optical clarity perfectly reflects the Rolls-Royce brand philosophy.
testimonial.author: Showroom Manager
